Container.Name: sidestash
Container.Overview:
Your own AltStore source, with a dashboard to run it. Upload an .ipa or build one in your fork on GitHub Actions; Sidestash reads its version and permissions, adds the release notes from GitHub and the App Store, and publishes it to /source.json for AltStore and other store apps.
It also watches the original repos for new releases and can sync your forks. The dashboard is at /admin and needs the admin password. IPAs, icons and settings are kept in the Data folder.
Container.Requires: Expose only the public paths (/, /source.json, /apps.json, /ipa/, /icons/, /fonts/, the favicons, and /base/ if you upload IPAs for builds); keep /admin on your LAN or Tailscale. The app runs as PUID:PGID (99:100 by default) and fixes the Data folder's ownership on start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the source and the dashboard.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where IPAs, icons, uploads and settings are saved. Keep this mapped so they survive restarts and updates.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address phones reach the source at, e.g. https://apps.example.com. Download links are built from it. Leave empty to use whatever address each request came in on.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the dashboard. Use something long and random; the dashboard refuses every sign-in while this is empty.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Fine-grained token limited to your forks: Actions read and write, Contents read (read and write, plus Workflows read and write, to use Sync fork). Needed to run builds.

Config.Name: Upload token
Config.Description: Long random string for scripts/upload.sh, to upload IPAs from your Mac without the password.

Config.Name: Update check hours
Config.Description: Hours between checks of the original repos for releases and your forks for new commits. 0 turns it off.

Config.Name: Upload link hours
Config.Description: How long the private link to a decrypted IPA uploaded for a build lasts.

Config.Name: Upload link downloads
Config.Description: How many times that link can be downloaded before it stops working.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as and owns the Data folder with.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as and owns the Data folder with.
